objective: Separate missing explicit preprocessing, perception specialization, and downstream CAD execution capability with a fixed model.

conditions.name: forced_ir
conditions.ir_builder: same model thread as CAD execution
conditions.cad_agent_input: validated IR plus images retained in the same conversation
conditions.causal_question: Does forcing explicit preprocessing improve the same Agent?

conditions.name: specialist_ir
conditions.ir_builder: independent thread using the same model
conditions.causal_question: Does task and context separation improve image-to-IR inference?

conditions.name: oracle_ir
conditions.causal_question: Can the CAD Agent execute when image inference error is removed?

interpretation.forced_ir_gt_baseline: The Agent policy lacked a mandatory explicit preprocessing stage.
interpretation.specialist_ir_gt_forced_ir: Context or role separation helps perception and reconstruction.
interpretation.oracle_ir_gt_specialist_ir: Image-to-IR capability or input identifiability remains limiting.
interpretation.oracle_ir_failure: Downstream planning, CAD translation, MCP, or verifier remains limiting.

reporting_rules: Never pool oracle_ir with normal benchmark accuracy.
Use paired samples and record every IR artifact and model trajectory.
Do not infer population causality from a single sample or replicate.
